package.name: dsh_ros2_safety
package.description: Generic real-time safety framework for dsh-ros2: the safety_monitor node with pluggable checkers (motion tracking/stall, feedback loss, watchdog, optional torque), a latched /safety/state machine, forensics ring buffer and a fixed-format VLM arbitration script. Robot-specific data sources, thresholds and lock actions are configured via the robot profile `safety` section (see docs/safety-handover.md).
